title: High Molecular Weight DNA Extraction of Pomegranate
author: Mariano Resendiz
materials: Qubit 4 Fluorometer to measure DNA concentration:
Add 199 μL from each of the other working solutions, designated for the DNA samples, to new tubes.
Begin by autoclaving all heat-resistant liquid reagents at a liquid phase for 20 minutes (L20)
Begin by autoclaving all heat-resistant liquid reagents in a liquid phase for 20 minutes (L20)

steps.title: Autoclave all reusable items
steps.instruction: Autoclave mortars, pestles, kimwipes (in foil packet with sand, glass rods or metal spatulas), 5 mL and 1 mL tips at gaseous phase G30.

steps.title: Prepare NIB buffer (200 mL)
steps.instruction: Make base by mixing 2 mL 1 M Tris pH 9.5, 4 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 20 mL 1 M KCl and water to 200 mL; autoclave; after cooling add 2 g PVP‑360, 0.116 g spermidine, 0.040 g spermine, 34.23 g sucrose; store; add 2 mL β‑mercaptoethanol (BME) on day of use.

steps.title: Prepare SWB buffer (250 mL)
steps.instruction: Make base by mixing 2.5 mL 1 M Tris pH 9.5, 5 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 25 mL 1 M KCl and water to 250 mL; autoclave; after cooling add 16 g sorbitol, 2.5 g PVP‑360, 42.79 g sucrose; add 2.5 mL BME on day of use.

steps.title: Prepare Carlson lysis buffer (200 mL)
steps.instruction: Make base by mixing 20 mL 1 M Tris pH 9.5, 4 mL 0.5 M EDTA, 56 mL 5 M NaCl, 4 g CTAB and water to 200 mL; autoclave; after cooling add 2 g PEG 8000; BME will be added later with the buffer.

steps.title: Prepare TE/EB storage buffer (100 mL)
steps.instruction: Make base by mixing 1 mL 1 M Tris pH 9.5, 0.2 mL 0.5 M EDTA, water to 100 mL, adjust pH to 8.0 with HCl; autoclave; on day of use add 500 µL BME and 12 µL RNase A (100 µg/mL) in resuspension buffer (50 mM Tris·Cl pH 8.0, 10 mM EDTA).

steps.title: Pre‑chill mortars and pestles
steps.instruction: Place four autoclaved mortars/pestles at room temperature, then transfer to –80 °C for at least 30 min (overnight preferred).

steps.title: Add sand to mortars
steps.instruction: Add 1 g of sand to each pre‑chilled mortar.

steps.title: Freeze and portion tissue
steps.instruction: Split 10 g pomegranate tissue into ~4 × 2.5 g batches (or half a 50 mL tube); place ~2.5 g flash‑frozen tissue in liquid nitrogen (LN₂) into each mortar.

steps.title: Grind tissue with sand and LN₂
steps.instruction: Grind tissue, sand, and LN₂ until a light‑green powder forms.

steps.title: Add NIB to powder
steps.instruction: When LN₂ dissipates, add ~10 mL NIB (with BME) directly into the mortar and crush to a fine powder; keep conditions cold to arrest redox reactions.

steps.title: Transfer powder to tubes
steps.instruction: Pour the light‑green powder into 50 mL tubes using an autoclaved spatula or sterile tool.

steps.title: Adjust NIB volume in tubes
steps.instruction: Add NIB (with BME) to each tube to reach 20–25 mL total; swirl for up to 15 min to homogenize and melt any remaining ice crystals.

steps.title: First sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL SWB to each tube; invert to mix pellet and SWB.

steps.title: Centrifuge first wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4000 g, 4 °C, 10 min; discard supernatant.

steps.title: Second sorbitol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat addition of 10 mL SWB, invert, centrifuge 4000 g, 4 °C, 10 min; discard supernatant. If tissue/DNA is limiting, collect supernatants in a separate tube.

steps.title: Add Carlson lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL Carlson lysis buffer (with BME) to each pellet; invert to homogenize.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes at 55–65 °C for 1 h; gently invert after 30 min; add 12 µL RNase A per tube (adjust proportionally if volume differs from 20–25 mL).

steps.title: Cool lysate
steps.instruction: Cool tubes to room temperature (~10 min); do not skip this step.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 20 mL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl (PCI); shake gently (~20 inversions); centrifuge 4000 g, 4 °C, 15 min.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous layer to a new tube, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 14–20 mL ice‑cold isopropanol (≈0.7× volume of aqueous phase, typically 15–20 mL); invert 10×.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 g, 4 °C, 45 min.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 3 M sodium acetate to the pellet suspension and incubate at –20 °C for 1 h.

steps.title: Overnight stirring
steps.instruction: Place the tube on an automatic stirrer and let the solution mix overnight.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant; add 20 mL ice‑cold 80 % ethanol; invert 10×; centrifuge 5000 g, 4 °C, 15 min.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the 80 % ethanol wash (add 20 mL, invert, centrifuge as above).

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet on an autoclaved kimwipe for 5–10 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL TE or EB buffer; incubate overnight (preferred) before QC.

steps.title: Nanodrop quality check
steps.instruction: Measure 260/280 (expect 1.8–2.0) and 260/230 (expect 2.0–2.2) ratios; typical yield ~20 µg in 200 µL (≈100 ng/µL, >100 ng/µL target).

steps.title: Prepare Qubit working solutions
steps.instruction: Add 199 µL Qubit dsDNA HS Kit Buffer to two 0.5 mL tubes (working solutions) and to a third tube for each DNA sample; vortex 2–3 s.

steps.title: Add dsDNA HS reagent
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL dsDNA HS reagent to each tube; vortex 2–3 s.

steps.title: Prepare standards
steps.instruction: Transfer 190 µL of each working solution to two new 0.5 mL tubes; add 10 µL Standard 1 to one (S1) and 10 µL Standard 2 to the other (S2); vortex 2–3 s.

steps.title: Add DNA samples
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of each DNA sample to its designated tube; vortex 2–3 s.

steps.title: Incubate Qubit tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate all standard and sample tubes at room temperature for 2 min.

steps.title: Calibrate Qubit fluorometer
steps.instruction: Select dsDNA HS assay on the Qubit 4; insert Standard 1 then Standard 2 to generate a calibration curve (should show increasing fluorescence).

steps.title: Measure DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Insert each DNA sample tube, press “Read tube”, and record the concentration in ng/µL.

steps.title: Optional repeat PCI cleanup
steps.instruction: If the aqueous phase appears brown (oxidized), repeat the phenol:chloroform:isoamyl extraction step.
